notes: Five distinct manipulation episodes are visible. The lounge backrest, grill hood, and cabinet-door timings are clear; the two folding-shelf off transitions are less certain because the camera is heavily rolled and the shelf joints are briefly out of view.
scene_description: A first-person camera surveys an apartment balcony containing a white adjustable lounge chair and a compact stainless-steel gas grill, then manipulates the chair backrest and four separate articulated grill parts.
